screens.alt: The console's Live screen for a fictional acme-platform installation: three runs -- one in its second round, in review with its verification passed; one in review with the near deadline flag; one queued -- two repositories, and the day's spend at 34.85% of a $120 daily cap.
The run-detail screen for run 20261020-103045-aa01 (acme/platform-core): its stage ledger, its build, test and lint verification, three findings and the tail of its log.
The Spend screen for a fictional acme-platform installation: thirty days of daily spend, the account totals, and the per-repository and default daily and per-run caps.

The installation picker on a console that has three installations -- acme-platform, acme-web and acme-data -- each naming the fixture CLI binary this run installed in its own temporary directory; its status line reads "acme-platform is the installation this console is showing (ok)." and the other two rows have not been read.
